# Tests of tests/e2e that fail on the GitHub runner and are left out by .github/workflows/e2e.yml.
#   file: <path>   a file whose every test fails: it is not run (a file with nothing to run starts its DSH and Chrome in `before`
#                  and never stops them, so the whole run hangs)
#   <name>         the start of the name of one test in a file that otherwise passes: it is skipped
#
# Found on 2026-11-19, when the suite first ran in CI (55 of 95 tests passed). Checked for the tests that wait for the Issues list, its tabs or its
# buttons: they look for the list layout, but the Issues widget opens in the conversation layout (ui/issues/view.js, DEFAULT_VIEW.layout 'chat',
# since 2026-11-18), so the page shows something else. The cause of the others was not looked at (the "write approval" tests of agent-sessions,
# the buttons of quick-cards and group-chat, the three "mobile embedded" tests whose probe plugin answers 404, the sidebar-logo tests, the Codex
# tool results in harness-resume, and so on): they may be out of date in the same way, or fail only on Linux.
# Remove a line when its test is up to date; the run then includes it.
